basic_profile.bio: A former military personnel turned meditation enthusiast. Having served in the army, I now seek peace and mindfulness through meditation and yoga. I have a keen interest in veteran affairs and often find myself discussing related topics online. Based in Colorado, I enjoy hiking and exploring nature in my free time. I'm typically online during the evenings after work, as I currently work as a security consultant. I'm single and enjoy the freedom to pursue hobbies like gaming and movie marathons on weekends.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: My knowledge is a mix of personal experience and self-taught skills. My military background has given me insight into veteran affairs, while my interest in meditation has been cultivated through self-learning via books and online resources. I've recently started exploring more about gaming and tech through various subreddits.
